PROCESS OPERATOR SPECIALIST, AIR SEPARATION UNIT (STARSHIP)

SpaceX is building its first production-scale Air Separation Unit (ASU) at Starbase to produce the high-purity liquid oxygen that powers Starship. This is not just another industrial plant—it is the critical on-site propellant factory that eliminates supply risk for the most ambitious launch vehicle ever built and lays the operational foundation for producing propellants on the Moon and Mars.

As a process operator specialist on the ASU team, you will operate and support cryogenic distillation, turboexpanders, centrifugal compressors, molecular sieve systems, and high-purity LOX production under the direction of Lead and Level 4/5 operators. You will monitor process parameters, execute approved procedures, complete thorough field rounds, and qualify toward independent watch standing. If you thrive in high-stakes cryogenic environments, want to learn these systems from first principles, and want ownership of mission-critical hardware as you grow, this is the role for you.

jobs.title: E-Space 2027 Summer Internship, Arlington TX
jobs.description_text: As a company, E-Space does not believe in sticking to the path that has already been trodden. We are encountering new problems every day that need new ways of thinking. Most aerospace internships hand you one project, one team, and a report-out slide at the end of summer. E-Space is different: we’re a vertically integrated space company building spacecraft manufacturing capability from the ground up in Arlington, TX, and we’re writing the playbook, rather than following someone else’s. That means our interns aren’t boxed into a single lane. Our previous interns have worked across multiple disciplines in a single cohort, pitched and built their own passion projects, and watched ideas they proposed become hardware that flies, not something that gets shelved after a final presentation. If you want the mission and scale of a rapidly scaling aerospace and defense company without layers of process that come with it, this is where you should build it yourself!

jobs.description_text: Zoox is building the world’s first purpose-built autonomous robotaxi. Fleet Operations keeps that fleet available, utilized, and safe, from 24/7 remote assistance and rider support to maintenance, repair, and on-road operations. We are hiring a Manager, Fleet Operations Training to own training for the full Fleet Operations workforce. This is not a corporate L&D role focused on leadership workshops. It is an operational training leadership job: you will run the function that certifies Crew to perform safety-critical work and keeps them current as the product, processes, and geographic footprint scale. The scope spans two training surfaces that must run to the same bar: Remote operations: This looks and feels like a high-stakes contact center: nested coaching, certification before live work, quality-driven upskilling, and trainer-to-learner ratios that have to hold as hiring ramps. Ground operations: All the on-the-ground work that it takes to operate our fleet, along with the training programs to enable our R&D Operations. This includes blended e-learning and hands-on and vehicle-in-the-loop training, with dedicated training vehicles and site infrastructure. You will lead a distributed organization of training program managers, instructional designers, training supervisors, trainers, and coordinators, and own the systems our training operations depend on.
